text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Samples 15.0 to 15.8 s. The car slides left and starts to rotate; at 15.4 s a closer overhead match cut makes the car and crowns larger. By 15.6 to 15.8 s the car has pivoted off the lower bank into the brown channel, tilted about 25 degrees, with a pale dotted foam burst at its right end and two or three thin curved pale wake strokes trailing to its left. A light gray rim shows around the body; a separate dark shadow offset from the car is not clearly distinguishable at this sample size. Car bottom stays just above the caption box.
